newsitem.title: UK: British dad hires minder for bullied son.
newsitem.headline: British dad hires minder for bullied son.

text.p: A British father, concerned about bullies attacking his teenage son, said on Friday he has hired a bodyguard to protect him.

Aldo Ferraro, an unemployed computer programmer from Swindon in southern England, is paying the martial arts expert 50 pounds ($78) a week to escort his son to school and guard him against physical attacks.
"There are thousands of children out there who are having trouble at school. They are like lambs to the slaughter," Ferraro said.
"I looked at my options and I had no options, this is the only way I could think of to protect my child."
The headmaster of Oakfield School in Swindon said in a statement the school had a "clear and firm policy that bullying is not accepted" and had dealt with any incidents in the past.
